title: fix: mark Discord username optional in publisher access triage
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Renames the field label to "Discord username (optional)" in the Community Publisher Access template; the description already said optional, but the triage bot and a reviewer still treated it as required (#14870, #14902)
- Adds one guideline to the new-issue triage prompt: never ask for fields the template marks optional

Addresses #14902

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Optional means optional
gist.blurb: The publisher-access form now says the quiet part out loud: Discord usernames are optional. The triage bot has also been reminded not to go collecting fields it does not need.
gist.summary: Renamed the Community Publisher Access field to “Discord username (optional)” and updated new-issue triage guidance so optional template fields are never requested as required.
gist.impact: Publisher-access applicants can submit without a Discord username and will no longer receive triage requests for that optional detail.
